Title: Preferred tool order
Text: 1. Read the frozen publication planning artifacts. 2. Read the deterministic `SECTION_CONTEXT_PATH` packet when provided as structural context for framing, completeness checks, factual-use eligibility, open items, and QA. 3. Read only the mapped KTY-local files permitted by the approved section map. 4. Use direct reasoning to synthesize the section body and QA artifact.

Title: TASK-enforced
Text: - None — this skill has no deterministic tool requirement, so the `allowed-tools` frontmatter field is intentionally omitted.

Title: Operationally invoked
Text: None by this skill. It consumes deterministic planning outputs produced upstream rather than invoking tools itself.

Title: Expected use of reasoning
Text: This skill is reasoning-heavy. It must: - interpret mapped inputs under `MappingRole` / `ContributionScope`, - use section context packets without promoting them to body-authoring authority except for the narrow `OVERVIEW` framing exception, - apply publication-rule precedence, - synthesize coherent engineering prose, - in `FULL_ENGINEERING_DBM` mode, preserve material engineering detail and design-basis tables in DBM-native body structure, - preserve uncertainty as `TBD`, assumptions, or conflicts rather than inventing reconciliations, - preserve uncertainty as `TBD`, assumptions, or conflicts rather than inventing reconciliations.

Title: Disallowed use
Text: - No dispatching of other skills or agents. - No guessed discovery of inputs outside the frozen planning artifacts. - No use of `_Aggregation/*`, `_Coordination/*`, `_Evaluation/*`, `_Reconciliation/*`, `_MEMORY.md`, or `_SEMANTIC.md` as content authority. `_MEMORY.md` may be read only as non-authoritative operational context whenever `_STATUS.md` is read. - No modification of any `CAT-* / 1_Working / KTY-*` source files. - No package-level assembly. - No use of QA/export scaffolds as the default body structure in `FULL_ENGINEERING_DBM` mode.

Title: Write boundary
Text: The skill may write only: - one section body markdown file, - one section QA markdown file.  All writes must remain inside the section-local publication folder named in the INIT-TASK brief.
